reader.requirement: At --std 85 IN and OF must be accepted interchangeably at every qualifier position of every qualification format (data-name/condition-name chains, file-name and cd-name qualifiers, paragraph IN section, LINE-COUNTER/PAGE-COUNTER/LINAGE-COUNTER qualifiers), with identical meaning.
reader.edition-search: the grammar alternatives spell (OF | IN) with no semantic predicate; grep of the qualification binders (DataBinder, ProcedureTableBuilder, CounterResolver) shows no edition test and no branch on the OF/IN token (the binder reads only the qualifier words).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses mix IN/OF in data-name and condition-name chains; not exercised: IN for a paragraph's section, for LINE-COUNTER's report-name, for a cd-name or file-name qualifier

probes.printed: X IN G IN R1B OF F2 receives 600; X OF G IN F2 and X OF R1B IN F2 both print 600; X-BIG IN X IN F2 -> C4 T
probes.expected: mixed IN/OF chains mean the same item

reader.notes: Every qualification production spells (OF | IN) as one alternative and the binder never looks at which keyword was written, so equivalence holds by construction at every edition; probes exercised IN in data, condition, cd, paragraph and report-counter qualification.
